app.name: Ultimate Tic Tac Toe
app.tagline: Fast matchmaking. Fair competition. Pure fun.

home.heroBody: Match randomly in seconds, climb the ranked ladder, compete with friends. A fair, fast, competitive experience.
home.modeCasualDesc: Quick matchmaking, guest or signed in
home.modeRankedDesc: Earn points, climb leagues, reach the top
home.modeBotDesc: Train against easy, medium or hard bots
home.modeLocalDesc: Take turns on the same screen
home.modeRoomDesc: Share a code for a private room
home.guideBody: One big board made of nine mini boards. Win the mini boards to claim the big one.
home.guide1Body: Each turn you may only move inside the highlighted mini board. The green outline shows where you can play.
home.guide2Body: The cell you pick decides which mini board your opponent must play next. Play the centre cell and they go to the centre board.
home.guide3Body: Win a mini board with three in a row and it becomes your mark. Line up three mini boards to win the match.
home.rankedRequiresAuth: Ranked requires signing in to an account.
home.specNote: 5 minutes plus 2 seconds per move · Ranked matches are scored with Glicko-2 · Every move is validated on the server
